Name: timestamp_pc
Description: Timestamp the record was decoded on the PC (YYYY-mm-DD HH:MM:SS).

Name: timestamp_receiver
Description: Timestamp the record was received on the datalogger (YYYY-mm-DD HH:MM:SS).

Name: id_received
Description: ID of the receiver (if set in the SD card).

Name: channel
Description: Radio channel of the receiver on which the packet was received.

Name: id_mbus
Description: Unique identifier of the sensor (i.e. CE260001)

Name: mbus_rssi
Description: Received signal strength in dBm (decibel milliwatts).

Name: sequence_number_instrument
Description: Sequence number of the transmitted packet (increments on each measurement).

Name: voltage_battery_mV
Description: Battery voltage of the instrument in millivolts.

Name: conductivity_mV
Description: Measured conductivity in millivolts.

Name: temperature_tmp117_degC
Description: Temperature within the instrument from the internal TMP117 in degrees celsius.

Name: pressure_keller_bar
Description: Pressure measured by the Keller pressure sensor in bar (may require re-calculation if the date code field is missing…).

Name: temperature_keller_degC
Description: Temperature measured by the Keller pressure sensor in degrees celsius.

Name: date_code_keller_raw
Description: Metadata from the Keller pressure sensor.

Name: mag_lsm303_x
Description: Raw instrument magnetometer data in x-axis: convert to Gauss with (value/2^15 * 50).

Name: mag_lsm303_y
Description: Raw instrument magnetometer data in y-axis: convert to Gauss with (value/2^15 * 50).

Name: mag_lsm303_z
Description: Raw instrument magnetometer data in z-axis: convert to Gauss with (value/2^15 * 50).

Name: acc_lsm303_x
Description: Raw instrument accelerometer data in x-axis: convert to g (Earth's gravitational field strength) with (value/2^15 * 2).

Name: acc_lsm303_y
Description: Raw instrument accelerometer data in y-axis: convert to g (Earth's gravitational field strength) with (value/2^15 * 2).

Name: acc_lsm303_z
Description: Raw instrument accelerometer data in z-axis: convert to g (Earth's gravitational field strength) with (value/2^15 * 2).

Name: acc_cti_tilt05_x_mg
Description: For Cryowurst raw accelerometer data from the Tilt-05 sensor in x-axis.

Name: acc_cti_tilt05_y_mg
Description: For Cryowurst raw accelerometer data from the Tilt-05 sensor in y-axis.

Name: acc_cti_tilt05_z_mg
Description: For Cryowurst raw accelerometer data from the Tilt-05 sensor in z-axis.

Name: pitch
Description: For Cryowurst calculated pitch data in degrees

Name: roll
Description: For Cryowurst calculated roll data in degrees

Name: sequence_number_receiver
Description: Receiver sequence number (not implemented).

Name: acc_receiver_x
Description: Raw datalogger accelerometer data in x-axis: convert to g (Earth's gravitational field strength) with (value/2^15 * 2).

Name: acc_receiver_y
Description: Raw datalogger accelerometer data in x-axis: convert to g (Earth's gravitational field strength) with (value/2^15 * 2).

Name: acc_receiver_z
Description: Raw datalogger accelerometer data in x-axis: convert to g (Earth's gravitational field strength) with (value/2^15 * 2).

Name: voltage_battery_receiver_raw
Description: Unprocessed datalogger battery voltage.

Name: voltage_shunt_ch1
Description: Raw shunt voltage on datalogger channel 1 (solar panel) multiply by 5e-6 and 0.1 to convert to current in Amps.

Name: voltage_bus_ch1
Description: Raw bus voltage on datalogger channel 1 (solar panel) multiply by 5e-3 to convert to Volts.

Name: voltage_shunt_ch2
Description: Raw shunt voltage on datalogger channel 2 (battery) multiply by 5e-6 and 0.1 to convert to current in Amps.

Name: voltage_bus_ch2
Description: Raw bus voltage on datalogger channel 2 (battery) multiply by 5e-3 to convert to Volts.

Name: voltage_shunt_ch3
Description: Raw shunt voltage on datalogger channel 3 (load) multiply by 5e-6 and 0.1 to convert to current in Amps.

Name: voltage_bus_ch3
Description: Raw bus voltage on datalogger channel 3 (load) multiply by 5e-3 to convert to Volts.

Name: relative_humidity_sht30
Description: Not fitted.

Name: temperature_sht30_raw
Description: Not fitted.

Name: pressure_ms5607_bar
Description: Air pressure from the datalogger MS5607 pressure sensor.

Name: temperature_ms5607_degC
Description: Temperature from the datalogger MS5607 pressure sensor.

Name: hex
Description: Raw message.
